confidence_scope: Confidence scores refer to accuracy of attribution and paraphrase, not an independent confirmation of financing terms, future permitting outcomes or experimental effects.

sources.title: Reuters: Data-centre opponents gain political influence after US midterms
checked_claims: Reuters reported on 4 November that opponents of new data centres gained political influence in several US state elections. Goldman Sachs analysts suggested temporary pauses could affect around 45% of planned US capacity expansion, but the scale and duration of any restrictions remain uncertain.
limitations: Goldman Sachs estimate is an analyst scenario, not a verified count of paused projects.
The potential effect of election results remains uncertain.

sources.title: OpenAI gets $11 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation, source says
checked_claims: On 6 November, Reuters reported, citing a person familiar with the matter, that OpenAI had closed $11 billion in new financing as an initial portion of a larger round valuing it at $1.25 trillion. Reuters cited investors who said the financing was below an earlier target and valuation.
limitations: Reuters attributes deal and valuation to informed sources; no independent review of final investment documentation.

sources.title: Google acquires Wyoming data center site from AI infrastructure firm Crusoe
checked_claims: Reuters reported on 6 November that Google acquired a southeast Wyoming data-centre site from AI infrastructure company Crusoe. Google had announced a $17 billion investment in the project the previous day. Reuters said the site transaction price was not disclosed.
limitations: Reported $17 billion is an investment announcement, not evidence that the campus is operating or complete.

sources.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
checked_claims: A 4 November arXiv preprint introduces a method called Coca-Cola for compressing tool observations into latent representations. Its authors report 70.01%–89.24% lower token consumption and 24.45%–55.97% shorter runtime on their tested web-search agent benchmarks.
limitations: Author preprint; results not independently replicated or proven in Sapiver Forge production.
